prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One whole apple in three-quarter view next to one neat half showing a star-like core and two seeds, clean broad contours. Correction: clean simple contour drawing only. Entire apple and leaf interiors must be completely empty white, with NO gray areas or lighting patches. Draw leaf smooth edged with three short veins only; sliced half shows one smooth core and two seed teardrops. Omit flesh texture and fine wrinkles.
